full_judgment: 17. It would rather be a futile attempt on my part to explain explicitly in the manner VR Krishna lyer, J. succinctly explained the scope of review of a judgment and order that "A plea for review, unless the first judicial view is manifestly distorted, is like asking for the moon. A forensic defeat cannot be avenged by an invitation to have a second look, hopeful to discovery of flaws and reversal of result". I respectfully agree with the above arguments of his Lordship about the limitation of this Court in reviewing a judgment and order which has been rendered finality on merit.
